title: Campaign Academy
subtitle: Recruit people into roles — not into "help us."
doctrine: People join roles, not organizations. Every position answers: How does my small piece help win Arkansas?

positions.title: County Volunteer Captain
positions.purpose: Build and support the volunteer team in your county.
responsibilities: Attend monthly county call
Recruit and welcome new volunteers
Coordinate local events and house parties
Report activity to campaign ops weekly
weeklyTasks: Confirm next local event on Mobilize
positions.reporting: Weekly county activity report to Steve / volunteer lead
positions.connectionToPlan: County captains turn the 75-county playbook into a living volunteer network — the bridge between strategy and Election Day turnout.

positions.title: Letters to the Editor Coordinator
positions.purpose: Make sure local voices are visible in local newspapers — real citizens, not campaign press releases.
responsibilities: Recruit 3–5 citizen writers in your county or region
Track letter submissions and publications
Encourage weekly participation
Follow Arkansas Citizen Voices workflow
weeklyTasks: Coach one writer on a personal letter
Confirm publication and share for amplification
successMetrics: 2 published letters per month in your market
positions.reporting: Regional LTE lead · Citizen Voices registry
positions.connectionToPlan: Earned media credibility money can't buy — local validation in every county newspaper market.

positions.title: Campus Captain
positions.purpose: Build student participation on your campus — registration, volunteers, and Kelly appearances.
responsibilities: Recruit student volunteers
Run voter registration tabling events
Coordinate Kelly campus appearances
Create Mobilize events for every tabling shift
successMetrics: Mobilize event for every public tabling shift
positions.reporting: Campus network lead · Students for Arkansas co-chairs
positions.connectionToPlan: Campus captains unlock the youngest persuadable voters and build a movement that survives past Election Day.

positions.title: Story Corps Lead
positions.purpose: Capture authentic vertical video — Kelly stops, volunteers, community voices, campus moments.
responsibilities: Film and edit short-form video after events
Coordinate with Leann / comms on publishing
Train backup shooters in your region
Hit 5 assets per Kelly stop in your area
weeklyTasks: Log assets in social resume pipeline
positions.connectionToPlan: Story Corps turns field presence into persuasion at scale — county algorithms before paid media.

positions.title: Power of 5 Leader
positions.purpose: Multiply relationships — every supporter recruits five trusted contacts through meaningful conversations.
responsibilities: Host or co-host small-room conversations
Recruit five Power of 5 commitments per month
Identify house party hosts in your network
Log conversations and follow-ups
weeklyTasks: Follow up with one new contact
Invite one person to host a gathering
successMetrics: 1 house party hosted or co-hosted per quarter
positions.reporting: Volunteer leadership · Po5 command center metrics
positions.connectionToPlan: Most persuasion happens in small rooms. Po5 leaders are the vote-generation engine beside HCI.

positions.title: Faith Outreach Lead
positions.purpose: Build respectful relationships with faith communities — civic engagement without partisan preaching.
responsibilities: Identify faith community connectors in your county
Schedule listening conversations
Coordinate Kelly or surrogate appearances
Report validator and introduction pipeline
successMetrics: 2 speaking or listening sessions per month
positions.connectionToPlan: Faith communities are trusted local institutions — relationship before persuasion.

positions.title: Union Outreach Lead
positions.purpose: Support Danny Brown and labor validators — Democratic Union Caucus and local union relationships.
responsibilities: Attend union meetings in your region
Distribute labor briefing materials
Introduce Kelly to local labor leaders
Report meetings to labor program owner
weeklyTasks: Confirm one union or labor meeting
positions.connectionToPlan: Labor relationships validate Kelly's working-class credibility — not just a message, a network.

positions.title: Mobilize Lead
positions.purpose: Ensure every event that needs volunteers has a live Mobilize page — no orphan field stops.
responsibilities: Create Mobilize events for qualifying stops
Assign volunteer shifts and roles
Sync with field calendar and stop command centers
Flag missing Mobilize warnings to ops
weeklyTasks: Audit next 7 days of field calendar for Mobilize gaps
positions.connectionToPlan: If volunteers are needed, Mobilize is required — the operating system for field execution.

positions.title: House Party Host
positions.purpose: Open your living room, backyard, or porch — small rooms where trust and ownership grow.
responsibilities: Host 8–15 neighbors, friends, or coworkers
Welcome guests and introduce Kelly or a surrogate
Collect Po5 commitments and volunteer interest
Complete thank-you closeout checklist
weeklyTasks: Coordinate with county captain or Po5 leader
positions.connectionToPlan: Large events create visibility. Small events create ownership — and ownership creates turnout.
